name: Lark
long_description:
Lark deploys AI agents for distributors to automate purchasing, demand forecasting, inventory monitoring, sales operations, and data analysis.

Our agents connect to the ERP, CRM, email, spreadsheets, and other software your team already uses. They forecast demand, prepare purchase orders, flag inventory issues, update sales records, and answer questions using your business data. Together, these agents can run a distributor’s entire operation.

We handle setup and tailor each agent to your workflows, business rules, and approval limits, so your team can automate recurring work while staying in control.
one_liner: AI agents that automate workflows for distributors

launches.title: Lark — AI agents for distributors
launches.tagline: Automate purchasing, inventory, and sales without replacing your ERP.
launches.body:
Hey YC! We’re Jason and Michael, brothers and co-founders of Lark.

**TL;DR:** Lark builds AI agents that automate the daily work of running a distributor. It recommends what to reorder, prepares purchase orders and supplier emails, monitors inventory, and keeps sales records current, all on top of the ERP you already use.

**The problem: distributors still run on email and spreadsheets**\
Distributors supply everything from construction materials to restaurant ingredients. Their teams still spend hours piecing together information across email, spreadsheets, and legacy software.

Take a basic question: what should we reorder today? A buyer has to check stock, customer orders, incoming deliveries, and sales history, then decide quantities and prepare purchase orders. The decisions often depend on rules experienced employees carry in their heads.

**How Lark works**\
<https://youtu.be/ZmQ8DWiVuv8>

* **Recommends what to order, when, and how much.** Lark connects to your systems and combines AI with inventory optimization algorithms. It uses each distributor’s own data and operating rules to reduce stockouts and excess inventory.
* **Prepares purchase orders and supplier emails for review.** Buyers can inspect the data behind every recommendation.
* **Works within your rules.** Teams set approval rules and limits so Lark can enter orders in the ERP and email suppliers automatically, logging each action.
* **Monitors inventory and sales.** Lark flags stalled opportunities and answers questions using your company’s data.

**Early results**\
Our first customer saves 50 hours a week by using Lark to automate ERP data entry and decide what to reorder.

**The team**\
**Jason** was the co-founder and CTO of Datost (backed by Y Combinator). Before that, he built AI agents for warehouse staffing at Traba, where he saw this exact problem across countless distributors. He has a degree in computer engineering from the University of Toronto, with minors in business and AI.

**Michael** was studying finance and management at NYU Stern before leaving to build Lark. Before that, he founded a nonprofit volunteer organization with over 10,000 volunteers and represented Canada in badminton.

**Our ask**\
If you run a distributor, or know someone who does, we’d love to connect. \
[Book a call](https://larkagents.cal.com/lark/demo-meeting) or learn more at [larkagents.com](https://larkagents.com).
